_doc: Codex entries. Each category's keys match ids in junk.json / plants.json / robots.json / shards.json / junk.json landmarks. Entries unlock when found: junk = first scooped, plants = first planted, robots = first built, shards = read, landmarks = Patch rolls near one. kg_per_unit converts compartment units of junk to kilograms for the Stats tab.

metal.desc: Cans, tins and bent brackets. Most of it was made to last, and it did. Pressed into bales, it can be rolled and stamped into something useful again.

plastic.desc: Bottles, crates and the occasional chair. It outlived the people who bought it. It weighs almost nothing, and still the ground under it stayed bare.

glass.desc: Jugs and wine bottles, a few still corked. Sorted by colour, glass melts down beautifully. Patch likes how the light comes through it.

rubber.desc: Tyres, boots and one very patient rubber duck. Rubber holds water, and water holds mosquitoes. Clearing it makes room for frogs.

electronics.desc: Laptops, radios and televisions with nothing left to say. Inside are tiny useful parts. Patch keeps the good ones for new friends.

paper.hint: Soft, and slowly going back to soil.
paper.desc: Cardboard boxes, bags and old gloves. Paper is the one kind of junk that is already trying to become soil. Patch helps it along.

grass.name: Meadow Grass
grass.desc: The first thing to come back, always. Its roots knit the loose dust together so other plants have something to hold on to.

grass2.name: Tufted Grass
grass2.desc: A slightly scruffier cousin. It grows in clumps, and small beetles like to live between them.

celandine.name: Celandine
celandine.desc: Glossy yellow petals that open in the sun and close when clouds pass. Bees find it before they find anything else.

gazania.name: Gazania
gazania.desc: A tough little sun-lover with striped petals. It does not mind poor soil. It seems to enjoy proving people wrong.

heliophila.name: Heliophila
heliophila.hint: The first flower you ever saw here.
heliophila.desc: Small blue flowers that turn to follow the light. One grew beside a crushed can before anyone helped it. That is where this all began.

dandelion.name: Dandelion
dandelion.desc: Golden today, a puff of wishes tomorrow. Each seed rides the wind to a new patch of clean ground. It plants itself, if you let it.

fern.name: Fern
fern.desc: Fronds that unroll like slow fireworks. Ferns are very old. They have come back from worse than this.

shrub.name: Shrub
shrub.desc: A low woody bush. Birds will notice it before you do. Shrubs are how a meadow starts thinking about becoming a wood.

nettle.name: Nettle
nettle.desc: Stingy, stubborn and wonderful. Nettles pull nutrients up from deep down, and caterpillars adore them.

mint.name: Wild Mint
mint.desc: Crush a leaf and the whole hex smells fresh. Mint spreads quickly. Nobody minds.

hedge.name: Hedgerow
hedge.desc: A dense green wall, alive with small rustlings. Hedges are highways for hedgehogs, and hotels for wrens.

pine.name: Pine Sapling
pine.desc: Knee-high today. In a hundred years, a forest that smells of resin and rain. Patch plants it carefully, for whoever comes after.

scoopie.desc: A small, earnest cleaner with one scoop arm and a lot of enthusiasm. It hums when it finds a good pile.

haulbug.desc: A fork cart that never complains. It carries loose bales to the scale and parks itself neatly afterwards.

seedling.desc: A planter bot with a seed hopper on its back. It pats every seed into the soil, twice, just to be sure.

drip.desc: A watering bot with a sloshy tank. It makes a little happy gurgle when a plant drinks.

multibot.desc: A helper that can clean, plant or water. Not the fastest at anything, but always where it is needed.

skimmer.desc: A little raft robot with a net and a rubber duck for luck. It drifts across the lakes fishing out bottles, and leaves neat bales on the shore.

back_soon.desc: A hand-lettered sign from a bakery. Marta promised to be back soon.

kid_drawing.desc: A crayon drawing, folded small enough to fit a pocket.

gardener_list.desc: Someone's to-do list for a garden. Half the items are ticked.

receipt.desc: A till receipt from the last ordinary day.

maint_log.desc: A maintenance log for a unit that looked a lot like Patch.

ledger_memo.desc: An office memo about the evacuation. Very polite. Very tired.

voicemail.desc: A voicemail transcript. Someone was calling to say they were safe.

poster.desc: A faded safety poster. The smiling robot on it is waving.

covered_car.name: Covered Car
covered_car.desc: Somebody covered it carefully before they left, as if they meant to come back for it. The tarp has held for a very long time.

concrete_road_barrier.name: Road Barrier
concrete_road_barrier.desc: Once it told traffic where to go. Now moss is slowly telling it where to stay.

exterior_aircon_unit.name: Air Conditioner
exterior_aircon_unit.desc: An old outdoor unit with a rusted fan. Small birds have started nesting behind the grille.

electric_stove.name: Abandoned Stove
electric_stove.desc: Someone carried it this far and then set it down. Its oven door still opens with a cheerful squeak.

Barrel_01.name: Old Barrel
Barrel_01.desc: Empty now, thankfully. Turned on its side it makes a decent shelter for a fox.

metal_trash_can.name: Trash Can
metal_trash_can.hint: The irony is not lost on Patch.
metal_trash_can.desc: The one place junk was supposed to go. Patch salutes it every time he passes.

propane_tank.name: Propane Tank
propane_tank.desc: Long since empty and safe. Someone painted a flower on the side, a long time ago.

plastic_monobloc_chair_01.name: Plastic Chair
plastic_monobloc_chair_01.desc: The most common chair in the world. It faces the horizon, as if someone liked to watch the sunset from here.

dead_tree_trunk.name: Old Tree Trunk
dead_tree_trunk.desc: A tree that did not make it. But there are tiny green shoots at its base, and beetles inside, and it is not as dead as it looks.

old_drill_press.name: Drill Press
old_drill_press.desc: A workshop drill press standing alone in a field. The workshop around it is long gone; the press stayed exactly where it was told.

old_military_compressor.name: Field Compressor
old_military_compressor.hint: Out where the wild bases are.
old_military_compressor.desc: A wheeled air compressor, its gauges frozen at 'enough'. It pumped up the tyres of a whole fleet of cleanup carts once.

tree_stump_01.name: Tree Stump
tree_stump_01.hint: Where a forest used to be.
tree_stump_01.desc: Cut, not fallen. The rings count back further than the Ledger. Moss has started a quiet negotiation with the bark.

ocean_buoy.name: Washed-up Buoy
ocean_buoy.desc: A channel buoy that drifted inland on a storm tide and never found its way back. Its lamp still blinks, once an hour, out of habit.

wooden_crate_02.name: Cargo Crate
wooden_crate_02.hint: Near the shore, or the dunes.
wooden_crate_02.desc: A slatted crate stencilled CRADLE SUPPLY: FRAGILE. Empty. Whatever was inside was planted somewhere, a long time ago.

barrel_03.name: Sand-Blasted Drum
barrel_03.desc: Centuries of wind have polished this drum down to bare, shining metal. In the dunes even the junk gets buffed.
